name: voibecode
displayName: VoibeCode — AI Agent Stall Watcher & Radar
description: Air traffic control for AI coding agents — detects stalled terminals (>10s), chimes on stalls, and dims to a zero-chrome twilight screen. 100% local metadata, zero telemetry.

voibecode.enabled.description: Enable VoibeCode zero-chrome twilight wait screen on terminal execution and agent stalls.

voibecode.stallThresholdSeconds.description: Seconds with zero terminal stdout bytes before transitioning to STALLED and sounding the 528->792Hz harmonic chime.

voibecode.idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds of focused editor inactivity before launching screensaver mode (set to 0 to disable).

voibecode.allowStallChimeWhenMuted.description: Play the 528->792Hz stall alert chime even when ambient synth drone audio is OFF.

voibecode.shufflePatronSkies.description: Rotate across claimed patron and maker skies automatically when wait state launches.

voibecode.showPatronCredits.description: Display bottom hairline brand attribution on claimed patron and maker skies.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --minify --outfile=dist/extension.js && esbuild src/webview-client.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/webview-client.js
